messages.text: Can you make some photos of my dog using this pic as the reference? I’ve been wanting to see him in a few different settings, and I’m a bit worried he might end up looking like a generic dog rather than himself. What I’m after is three separate square photos: one on a sandy beach, one on a snowy forest trail, and one in a cosy living room. It should look like this same dog in every one, not just any golden retriever. Please keep him natural, with no clothes or text.
